predictions.mechanism: Large payroll upside surprise raises the probability of near-term Fed tightening, lifting USD and yields and pressuring precious metals and rate-sensitive equities.
predictions.invalidation: A materially soft next-week CPI or a rapid reversal lower in DXY and Treasury yields would weaken the hawkish interpretation.
